weakest_scene.root_cause: The beat's claim is a ratio, but the scene spends most of its time on a door reveal with no subject inside. Data is placed as a pointer instead of the cause of the motion.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Data drives the pods out of the door into lanes alongside the workers, two pods slotting in next to each three-person row as he steers them. The 2:3 pairing should build visibly in rows from the first second and land by about 70% of the beat.
